create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn graph by adding start and accept nodes then connecting them with labeled weighted arcs
test_graph_equality: test whether two gtn graphs are equal by comparing nodes arcs labels outputs and weights
test_graph_isomorphism: test whether two gtn graphs are isomorphic ignoring node ordering but checking structure and arc properties
save_and_load_graph_binary: save a gtn graph to a binary file and load it back to verify equality and isomorphism
save_and_load_graph_text: save a gtn graph to a text file with savetxt and load it back with loadtxt
